name: read_table
author: hprebar
title: Read table
description: Read structured Excel table (ListObject) headers, data rows as JSON records, and totals row. Read-only.

sheet.description: Worksheet containing the table. If omitted, searches all worksheets.

workbook.description: Workbook name or file path. Defaults to active workbook.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of data rows to return.
